page.overview:
What is Law enforcement agency?

A law enforcement agency, also referred to as a planetary security force, police force, or security force, was an organization charged with enforcing laws, maintaining order, and protecting life and property. They were staffed by police officers or some cases soldiers and were generally structured as a paramilitary force or militia though they were rarely armed for full scale war. Sometimes police droids were utilized to supplement sentient peacekeepers in larger agencies or for smaller outposts and space stations.

A law enforcement agency, also called a police force or security force, was an organization charged with maintaining order, enforcing laws, and protecting life and property. Some law enforcement agencies also served as a military for their local governments, however they simply kept the peace and were not armed for full scale war.

Law enforcement was generally conducted on a local or planetary level but their size, functions, and training could vary greatly. They could be a small, volunteer local security force, or responsible to protect a whole, densely urbanized planet such as the Coruscant Security Force. Some served primarily as bodyguards and elite security forces, such as the Senate Guard; others were volunteer security and policing corps such as the Royal Security Forces on the planet Naboo. During the Invasion of Naboo, several hundred Royal Guards and police formed an underground resistance effort against the Trade Federation Droid Army.

The Jedi Order had policing authority under the Galactic Republic and could conduct criminal investigations and make arrests. Some even became experienced in local criminal and policing matters. However, the Jedi served the Republic as a whole as keepers of the peace and guardians of justice, leaving most planetary matters to local police. Jedi Master Dooku took notice of how many of the Republic's politicians saw the Jedi as little more than their personal, glorified police during the later years of the Republic, something that greatly upset him.
